commercialPurpose: Create a media/news homepage with a clear lead story, category scanning, and mixed article formats.
purposeLayer: Resource section turns content volume into an editorial hierarchy instead of a plain list.
anatomyLayer: Top nav, lead story image/text pair, category chip row, article cards, dark featured media band, video/card grid, author block, and footer links.
hierarchyLayer: Lead story first, category row second, article grids third, featured media band fourth.
gridRhythmLayer: Editorial homepage stack with one lead story, compact category carousel, article grids, and a dark media feature band.
originalityLayer: Extract section grammar only; do not copy exact artwork, imagery, spacing, copy, color identity, brand marks, or section order.
usageRuleLayer: Use for blog, magazine, news, resource hub, creator, and content marketplace templates.
layoutGesture: news portal lead story with channel grid and featured media band
sectionSilhouette: light editorial page where lead article gives way to category cards and a dark gallery strip
compositionTension: news hierarchy balances scanning density with one dominant story anchor
focalPath: lead image to headline to categories to article grids to media band
negativeSpaceShape: white gutters around article cards with a strong dark interruption band
depthLayering: light page base, card thumbnails, dark feature band, author/footer blocks
moduleScaleVariation: one large lead story, many small article cards, medium video tiles
breakoutBehavior: dark featured band breaks out from otherwise light editorial flow
antiCopyBoundary: Do not copy Beritain article images, category names, exact card order, or dark gallery styling.
